title: Moderate strong-coupling window and full-lattice boundary
analyticClaims: The normalized complete-root ledger has the three-term upper bound stated in report equations (0.5) and (0.8).
The exact corrected common-band family closes uniformly for 1 lesssim epsilon lesssim p^(2/3) R^(2/3) (1+log R), with decay under the corresponding little-o relation.

No nonzero finite coordinate-support subspace is invariant under a nonzero real-carrier full-lattice convolution, and the first omitted-shell norm ratio in the single-carrier example is exactly 1/sqrt(2).
finiteDiagnostics: Panel B normalizes suppressed absolute constants to one and therefore visualizes scaling rather than a sharp numerical theorem constant.
Panel C uses deterministic binary64 RK4 integration of the exact projected three-mode ODE for seven sigma values.
The projected ODE deletes the plus-or-minus 2R shell and is not an invariant full-lattice subsystem.
claimBoundary: The moderate window and non-embedding proposition are analytic statements in research/r072l_report-source.md. Finite plotted values do not prove those statements, do not resolve arbitrarily strong coupling or multiscale absorption, and do not imply a continuation criterion or general three-dimensional Navier-Stokes regularity.
